fields.description: Required for PRE_PRODUCED and MADE_TO_ORDER policies. Optional for DIRECT_RETAIL policy. Scope for production capacity, availability calculations, and work order routing.
fields.label: Production Unit

fields.description: Controls how item availability is calculated: PRE_PRODUCED (stock-based availability, requires Production Unit), MADE_TO_ORDER (capacity-based availability from BOM components, requires Production Unit), DIRECT_RETAIL (stock-based availability without Production Unit).
fields.label: Production Policy

fields.description: Only meaningful when Production Policy is PRE_PRODUCED (MADE_TO_ORDER is always in-house at order time; DIRECT_RETAIL is already a receipt-only path via Direct Retail Warehouse). IN_HOUSE: batch is manufactured at this branch/unit via a real BOM-based Manufacture Stock Entry. EXTERNAL_RECEIPT: item arrives already finished from a central kitchen/processing location and is received directly as finished stock, no BOM consumption.
fields.label: Sourcing Mode

fields.description: When checked (default), item availability requires an active approved/locked sales plan for the branch/department. When unchecked (an explicit opt-out), item availability is based on stock (PRE_PRODUCED) or production capacity (MADE_TO_ORDER) alone, without plan requirement.
fields.label: Controlled by Sales Plan

fields.description: When checked and plan is exhausted, allows selling/producing beyond the approved plan quantity if stock (PRE_PRODUCED) or production capacity (MADE_TO_ORDER) is available. Only applicable when Controlled by Sales Plan is enabled.
fields.label: Allow Over-Plan Sale

fields.description: Controls availability override behavior. 'Plan Available' (default/safe): normal plan+stock based availability checking, no override. 'Always Available' makes the item sellable regardless of plan/stock constraints (but never overrides structural/config errors such as a missing BOM). 'Stock Available' semantics are reserved for future clarification (not yet implemented).
fields.label: Availability Mode
fields.options:
Plan Available
Stock Available
Always Available

fields.description: Warehouse the finished item is received into when produced off-site (e.g. a central kitchen/processing location). Used by the Receive Batch action instead of the BOM-based Manufacture Stock Entry.
fields.label: External Receiving Warehouse
